note: The OLG covers the $125 earned income change reporting threshold under Change Reporting Overview ('earned income that is more than $125.00 per month') and provides extensive BEACON procedures for prospective budgeting (Prospective tab, Calculate Monthly Prospective Amount). Income averaging is addressed under Types of Earned Income > Income Averaging, including mandatory averaging for annual-income-in-shorter-period and optional averaging for fluctuating income. However, several FNS 1063 requirements are not covered: (1) The OLG does not address vacation/sick pay treatment — FNS requires counting it as income in the month received, as the same source as normal pay, or as a non-recurring lump sum if from a terminated source. (2) The OLG does not specify income conversion multipliers (weekly x 4.333, biweekly x 2.167) — BEACON's Prospective tab handles conversion automatically, but the written guide only says 'you must convert it to a monthly figure' without stating the factors. (3) The OLG does not reference FNS Section 722's framework for determining whether new/terminated source income is used in benefit calculations, though it does cover job ending procedures operationally at IR and recertification. (4) The Simplified Reporting IR page states 'The $125 reporting threshold only applies to unearned income' at IR — this is correct Massachusetts policy for Simplified Reporting (any earned income change must be reported at IR regardless of amount), but it differs from the Change Reporting standard where $125 applies to both earned and unearned income; the OLG does not clarify this distinction explicitly.
